name: study-collab-platform
description: Production-grade collaborative study platform with real-time whiteboard, chat, and WebRTC.

scripts.check: node --check server/server.js && node --check server/socket/index.js && node --check server/config/env.js
scripts.check:prod-config: node -e "process.env.NODE_ENV='production'; try { require('./server/config/env'); console.log('production config ok'); } catch (err) { console.error(err.message); process.exit(1); }"
